title: Rodin Gen 2.5 (Hyper3D)
summary: A generative AI platform for high-fidelity 3D asset creation that produces sculpting-grade geometry and production-ready topology from text or image prompts. It utilizes the 10-billion parameter BANG architecture to decompose complex objects into modular, high-detail parts.
research_notes: Developed by DeemosTech; the project transitioned from research previews to the integrated Hyper3D creator platform for professional game and VFX workflows.

evolution.summary: Following the 10B-parameter BANG architecture release in late 2025 (Gen 2), the 2.5 update introduces ultra-detailed surface sculpting and 'Smart Low-Poly' export features with automated normal map baking.
